text.hi: अपनी किताब में पेज 30 पर वल्लभ भाई स्कूल, भोपाल का नोटिस पढ़ो, फिर जवाब दो।
text.hinglish: Apni kitaab mein page 30 par Vallabh Bhai School, Bhopal ka notice padho, phir jawab do.
text.en: Read the notice of Vallabh Bhai School, Bhopal on page 30 of your book, then answer.

steps.sentence: Anurag has put up a ___ on his school noticeboard.

meaning.hi: अनुराग ने स्कूल के नोटिस बोर्ड पर एक सूचना लगाई है।
meaning.hinglish: Anurag ne school ke notice board par ek soochna lagaayi hai.

steps.sentence: Anurag is the ___ secretary of Vallabh Bhai School.

meaning.hi: अनुराग वल्लभ भाई स्कूल का सांस्कृतिक सचिव है।
meaning.hinglish: Anurag Vallabh Bhai School ka saanskritik sachiv hai.

steps.question: Which ceremony was being held at Vallabh Bhai School?

questionMeaning.hi: स्कूल में कौन सा समारोह था?
questionMeaning.hinglish: School mein kaun sa samaaroh tha?

steps.modelAnswer: A tree plantation ceremony was being held at Vallabh Bhai School on 15th October 2006.

modelMeaning.hi: वल्लभ भाई स्कूल में 15 अक्टूबर 2006 को वृक्षारोपण समारोह था।
modelMeaning.hinglish: Vallabh Bhai School mein 15 October 2006 ko vrikshaaropan samaaroh tha.

steps.question: How many plants are to be contributed by each class?
steps.modelAnswer: Each class should contribute a minimum of five plants.

modelMeaning.hi: हर कक्षा को कम से कम पाँच पौधे देने हैं।
modelMeaning.hinglish: Har kaksha ko kam se kam paanch paudhe dene hain.

steps.question: Name and designation of the student who wrote the notice:

questionMeaning.hi: नोटिस लिखने वाले का नाम और पद
questionMeaning.hinglish: Notice likhne waale ka naam aur pad

steps.question: Which word in the notice means ‘complete and enthusiastic’?

questionMeaning.hi: किस शब्द का मतलब ‘पूरे जोश वाला’ है?
questionMeaning.hinglish: Kis shabd ka matlab ‘poore josh waala’ hai?
